name: Onion skin settings compare distinct poses and survive project reload without painting ghosts
description: A previous-frame red ghost must be distinct from the active artwork, respond to F3, and retain its configured range and tint after the project is saved and reopened.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the local PixiBun Studio at a 1440 by 900 desktop viewport.
Draw a small mark near the left side of frame one.
Draw a separate mark near the right side of frame two.
Open Onion skin settings using the timeline gear.
Set the previous tint to red.
Select frame two, because projects reopen on their first frame.
Verify previous count is one, next count is zero and the red tint was restored in the settings dialog.
Toggle onion skin off with F3 while the drawing canvas has focus.
Verify the previous-frame red ghost disappears while frame two's painted mark is unchanged; the two frames still contain their own separate marks.
